mechanism_narrative: An increase in the Consumer Price Index (CPI) above 2.5% annualized over the previous 3 months signals inflationary pressure, leading to tighter monetary policy expectations and negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: If CPIAUCSL annualized growth exceeds 2.5% and SPX 20-day forward returns are positive in more than 40% of the triggered instances.

mechanism_narrative: A sharp increase in the unemployment rate (UNRATE) by more than 0.5 percentage points in one month indicates a weakening labor market, which leads to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: If UNRATE increases by more than 0.5pp and SPX 5-day forward returns are positive in more than 60% of the triggered instances.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained increase in housing starts (HOUST) over a 3-month period signals strengthening demand in the housing market, which is a leading indicator of economic growth and positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: If HOUST shows a sustained increase over 3 months and SPX 60-day forward returns are negative in more than 40% of the periods.

mechanism_narrative: A decline in industrial production (INDPRO) by more than 1% over the previous 3 months signals a contraction in supply, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: If INDPRO declines by more than 1% and SPX 20-day forward returns are positive in more than 50% of the triggered instances.

mechanism_narrative: When real personal consumption expenditures (RSAFS) grow by more than 2% over the previous 2 months, it indicates strong consumer demand, which is a positive signal for S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: If RSAFS grows by more than 2% and SPX 20-day forward returns are negative in more than 40% of the triggered instances.

mechanism_narrative: When the federal funds rate (FEDFUNDS) is above 4% and the unemployment rate (UNRATE) is below 3.5%, it indicates a tight labor market with high interest rates, which leads to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
regime_hint: tight monetary policy with low unemployment
failure_condition: If FEDFUNDS > 4% and UNRATE < 3.5% and SPX 60-day forward returns are positive in more than 50% of the triggered instances.

mechanism_narrative: A significant increase in nonfarm payrolls (PAYEMS) by more than 300,000 in a single month signals strong labor market conditions, which is a positive indicator for S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: If PAYEMS increases by more than 300,000 and SPX 5-day forward returns are negative in more than 60% of the triggered instances.

mechanism_narrative: When GDP (GDPC1) growth is negative for two consecutive quarters, it signals a recessionary environment, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
candidate_trigger: GDPC1 negative growth for 2 consecutive quarters
failure_condition: If GDPC1 shows negative growth for two consecutive quarters and SPX 60-day forward returns are positive in more than 40% of the triggered instances.
